name: gods-eye-view
description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
one_liner: A browser-based 3D globe showing real-time planes, ships, satellites, and public cameras around the world, like a real-life spy-satellite view.
buyer: A news/explainer YouTuber or journalist who needs dramatic, accurate visuals for a breaking-news story without stock footage.
business_use_cases: A news channel records live globe footage to illustrate a geopolitical event instead of buying stock footage.
A logistics company embeds a branded version to let customers track shipping/flight data visually.
An educator uses it as a live teaching tool for geography or current-events classes.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a white-label/branded embed for media companies who want the globe on their own site.
Sell premium data layers (higher-res imagery, historical replay) as a paid tier.

steal_this: Record a week's worth of dramatic globe clips and sell them as a stock-footage pack to news YouTubers this weekend.
